claim: The Chicago Architecture Center River Cruise aboard First Lady is a 90-minute (1.5 hour) tour starting at $57, departing from 112 E. Wacker Drive, voted #1 best boat tour in the US by USA Today.
quote: Starting at $57 ... 1.5 hours ... Northeast corner of Michigan Ave. and E. Wacker Dr (112 E. Wacker Drive) ... Voted the #1 best boat tour in the United States by USA Today ... #1 Chicago Boat Tour for 10+ years

claim: The Chicago Architecture Center River Cruise aboard First Lady was named one of the best experiences in the U.S. in Tripadvisor's 2026 Travelers' Choice 'Best of the Best' awards.
quote: The Chicago Architecture Center River Cruise aboard First Lady has just been named one of the best experiences in the U.S. in Tripadvisor's 2026 Travelers' Choice 'Best of the Best' awards

claim: Wendella's 90-minute architecture tour costs $45 adult / $20 kids (4-12), covers all three branches of the Chicago River and more than 50 architectural icons.
quote: Adults (13+): $45 ... Kids (4-12): $20 ... all three branches of the Chicago River ... more than 50 architectural icons

claim: Shoreline Sightseeing offers three architecture cruise lengths in 2026: 60-min Classic at $39, 75-min Signature at $46, and 90-min Deep Dive at $46, covering over 40 sites across all three river branches.
quote: 60-Minute Classic: $39 ... 75-Minute Signature: $46 ... 90-Minute Deep Dive: $46 ... over 40 iconic sites ... travel along all three branches of the Chicago River

claim: Chicago Architecture Center uses highly trained volunteer docents while other operators use operator-trained narrators; the single most important booking decision is route (all three branches) rather than operator.
quote: highly trained and enthusiastic volunteer CAC docents provide visitors with a compelling and detailed narrative ... If you only have one shot at the river, pay the small premium for a 90-minute three-branch sailing

claim: The Chicago Lakefront Trail runs 18.5 miles along Lake Michigan, is free and open 24 hours, and connects four parks, six public beaches (including Oak Street, North Avenue, Montrose) and four cultural museums.
quote: 18.5 miles along Lake Michigan, from Ardmore Avenue in Edgewater to 71st Street in South Shore ... six public beaches ... Oak Street Beach ... North Avenue Beach ... completely free to use ... open 24 hours

claim: Bike rental for the Lakefront Trail runs about $18/24-hour Divvy pass or $12-16/hour ($40-55/day) at private shops like Bike & Roll and Bobby's Bike Hike.
quote: Divvy bikeshare: Around $18 for a 24-hour pass ... Private shops: $12-16/hour or $40-55/day at locations like Bike & Roll and Bobby's Bike Hike

claim: The 606 (Bloomingdale Trail) is a free 2.7-mile elevated rail-to-trail park running ~20 feet above street level through Wicker Park, Bucktown, Logan Square and Humboldt Park, drawing over one million users a year.
quote: The 606 stretches 2.7 miles ... running about 20 feet above street level ... Wicker Park, Bucktown, Logan Square, and Humboldt Park ... free to use ... more than one million locals and visitors each year
